# Community Rule Column 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 8 | **Condition:** complete

---

**8:1** In the-council-of the-community there-shall-be twelve men and three priests, perfect-ones in all

**8:2** that-has-been-revealed from the-whole-of the-Torah, to-practice truth and righteousness

**8:3** and justice and covenant-faithfulness and humility, each-man with his neighbor,

**8:4** to-preserve faithfulness in-the-land with a steadfast purpose and a broken spirit, and to-atone-for

**8:5** sin by-practicing justice and by-enduring the-affliction-of the-refining-furnace, and to-walk with all-men by-the-measure-of

**8:6** truth and by-the-regulation-of the-time. When these-things exist in Israel,

**8:7** the-council-of the-community shall be established in truth, as an eternal planting,

**8:8** a house-of holiness for Israel, and a foundation-of the-holy-of

**8:9** holies for Aaron, true witnesses for-the-judgment, and chosen-ones-of the-will-of-God to-atone

**8:10** for the-land and to-render to the-wicked their recompense. This-is the-tested wall,

**8:11** the precious corner-stone; its foundations shall not shake and shall not

**8:12** be-moved from their place. A dwelling-of the-holy-of holies

**8:13** for Aaron, with-knowledge for-all, for a-covenant-of justice, and to-offer-up a pleasing-fragrance; and a-house-of

**8:14** perfection and truth in Israel, to-establish a covenant according-to the-everlasting statutes. And they-shall-be-accepted to-atone

**8:15** for the-land and to-determine the-judgment against wickedness, and there-shall-be no more injustice. When these-ones have-been-established

**8:16** in the-foundation-of the-community for two years in perfection-of way, they-shall-be set-apart as-holy

**8:17** in-the-midst-of the-council-of the-men-of the-community. And every matter that-has-been-hidden from Israel but-has-been-found

**8:18** by the-man who-is-searching — he shall not hide it from these-ones out-of fear of a spirit-of

**8:19** apostasy. And when these-things come-to-be for the-community in Israel, by-these

**8:20** regulations they-shall-be separated from the-midst-of the-dwelling-of the-men-of injustice to go

**8:21** to the-wilderness to-prepare there the-way-of Him, as it-is-written:

**8:22** "In-the-wilderness prepare the-way-of the LORD; make-straight in-the-desert a highway

**8:23** for-our-God." This-is the-study-of the-Torah which he-commanded by-the-hand-of Moses, to-do

**8:24** according-to all that-has-been-revealed from-time to-time, and as the-prophets revealed by his spirit-of

**8:25** holiness. And every man from the-men-of the-community, the-covenant-of

**8:26** the-community, who turns-aside from any-of the-commandments deliberately — he shall not touch the-pure-food-of

**8:27** the-men-of holiness, and he shall not know any-of their counsel, until his deeds are-purified from all injustice.

---

*EMET notes: Column 8 is the foundational passage describing the inner council of twelve men and three priests. The Isaiah 40:3 citation (lines 21-23) is pivotal to the community's self-understanding as a wilderness movement. "Holy-of holies" (qodesh qodashim) is applied to the community itself as a spiritual temple. Hyphenated compounds preserve Hebrew construct chains throughout.*
